records.name: Marketing homepage
records.current_verified_behavior: Public responsive marketing page on www with current inbound-deal-system copy.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Live reachability does not prove conversion or source canonicality.
records.owner_question: Is this current positioning the approved production narrative?

records.name: Legal and privacy pages
records.current_verified_behavior: Privacy, terms, and data-deletion information pages are reachable.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Legal adequacy was not assessed.
records.owner_question: Which specialist owns legal review and retention language?

records.name: Partner start / Click-to-Scale entry
records.current_verified_behavior: Partner/start route and branded entry surfaces exist in code.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Live partner-domain and configuration parity are not fully proven.
records.owner_question: Which partner domains and configurations are canonical?

records.name: Signup and login
records.current_verified_behavior: Email/password login and signup surfaces exist; protected routes redirect anonymous users to login.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Authenticated success, failure, MFA, social login, lockout, and recovery completion were not exercised.
records.owner_question: What is the approved production authentication acceptance matrix?

records.name: Password recovery
records.current_verified_behavior: Client exchanges fragment tokens for a session.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Tokens remain in fragment on session exchange failure.
records.owner_question: Must recovery be isolated from all third-party scripts?

records.name: Workspace and entitlement recovery
records.current_verified_behavior: App layout resolves authentication, workspace, and billing context before rendering product surfaces.
records.problems_or_contradictions: One recovery branch depends on a header the proxy does not set.
records.owner_question: What is the single source of truth for active workspace selection?

records.name: Onboarding draft and plan
records.current_verified_behavior: Captures profile, company, market, offer, budget, audience, and plan inputs.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Full draft PII is globally persisted in localStorage without TTL/user binding.
records.owner_question: Which draft fields truly need browser persistence?

records.name: Campaign creation and plan
records.current_verified_behavior: Creates campaign and campaign-plan data through campaign/build routes.
records.problems_or_contradictions: End-to-end production persistence and schema parity were not proven.
records.owner_question: What campaign-plan contract is authoritative?

records.name: AI builder command
records.current_verified_behavior: Command, copy-assistant, and section-assistant APIs support guided building.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Current model/provider behavior and spend controls were not live tested.
records.owner_question: Which AI actions require explicit cost confirmation?

records.name: Funnel generation
records.current_verified_behavior: Generates and edits campaign funnel content.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Published output can surface internal template labels and weak copy.
records.owner_question: What copy-quality gate blocks publication?

records.name: Funnel publication
records.current_verified_behavior: Publishes a public funnel at a slug.
records.problems_or_contradictions: The safely viewed live funnel contained internal template labels, repetition, and grammar defects.
records.owner_question: Should publication require customer-safe copy validation and preview approval?

records.name: Public lead form
records.current_verified_behavior: Collects name, email, phone and explicit SMS consent.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Submission was not performed; write path remains source-only.
records.owner_question: What production-safe synthetic-lead mechanism is approved?

records.name: Lead capture API
records.current_verified_behavior: Validates and inserts canonical lead then queues side effects.
records.problems_or_contradictions: A secret-gated load-test bypass can skip Turnstile/rate limits while retaining real effects.
records.owner_question: Must test traffic be forced into an isolated non-provider tenant?

records.name: Lead alert notification
records.current_verified_behavior: Queued job attempts an internal SMS/lead alert.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Failure truth and idempotency are not durably separated from other effects.
records.owner_question: What is the required retry/duplicate policy for each notification?

records.name: Meta CAPI lead event
records.current_verified_behavior: Queued job attempts Meta lead conversion delivery.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Per-effect durable completion/retry proof is missing.
records.owner_question: What conversion idempotency key and retention policy are authoritative?

records.name: GHL CRM lead sync
records.current_verified_behavior: Searches/creates contact and creates opportunity, recording sync event state.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Mapping integrity, request timeout, idempotency, and failed-event retry consumption are deficient or unproven.
records.owner_question: Is GHL the canonical CRM and what cross-workspace mapping invariant is mandatory?

records.name: Static creative generation
records.current_verified_behavior: Queues or runs static creative generation with media validation and QA metadata.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Provider worker/runtime, client DTO exposure, pass state, and spend behavior not live proven.
records.owner_question: Which provider path is canonical and what proof gates selection?

records.name: Video / UGC generation
records.current_verified_behavior: Supports Higgsfield/HeyGen-style video generation and job tracking.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Dedicated worker deployment unproven; temp cleanup absent.
records.owner_question: Who owns a supervised worker and queue-lag SLO?

records.name: Creative intake and selection
records.current_verified_behavior: Collects intake and stores selected ad/UGC asset choices.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Selection permits zero UGC while launch requires at least one.
records.owner_question: What is the authoritative launchable-selection invariant?

records.name: Creative preview and provenance
records.current_verified_behavior: Renders creative previews with internal asset/provider metadata supplied to a client component.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Provider IDs, storage paths, prompts/hashes, and raw status are over-serialized.

records.name: Billing status and entitlements
records.current_verified_behavior: Resolves plan, subscription state, capture/launch/generation entitlements.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Deployed webhook/schema state and lifecycle transitions were not live proven.
records.owner_question: Which billing state machine is product-authoritative?

records.name: Checkout and billing portal
records.current_verified_behavior: Creates checkout or portal sessions.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Not invoked due spend/external-mutation boundary.
records.owner_question: What isolated Stripe test-project proof is required before launch?

records.name: Generation credits
records.current_verified_behavior: Tracks credit balance/ledger and controlled overdrafts.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Concurrency and live ledger correctness were not tested.
records.owner_question: What is the approved overdraft/refund/reconciliation policy?

records.name: Meta connection and OAuth
records.current_verified_behavior: Creates signed OAuth state, stores encrypted token, returns to app.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Backslash redirect, scope/version split, and live connection state remain concerns.

records.name: Meta account/page/pixel selection
records.current_verified_behavior: Loads and stores Meta selections for launch.
records.problems_or_contradictions: Provider contract and tenant-scoped live behavior not exercised.
records.owner_question: What must be revalidated at every launch?

records.name: Dashboard and performance

records.problems_or_contradictions: Authenticated data, empty/error states, and active-workspace isolation not live tested.
